name: Crowdust
source:
A haughty princess. A mysterious soldier. A pushy socialite. And a family curse to hang over it all.

Using the Crown Prince's wedding as a convenient excuse, you head to the Kingdom of Lysium to find any information that might break the curse breathing down your neck. Everyone here seems to have a secret, but how can you know who will keep yours?

[from [url=https://azurecoffin.itch.io/crowdust]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个高傲的公主。一位神秘的士兵。一个咄咄逼人的社交名流。家庭的诅咒笼罩着这一切。

以王储的婚礼为借口，你前往利西姆王国寻找任何可能打破你脖子上的诅咒的信息。这里的每个人似乎都有一个秘密，但你怎么知道谁会保守你的秘密呢？

[来自[url=https://azurecoffin.itch.io/crowdust]itch.io[/url]]
